ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 88% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels are localized to the trailing edges, distal tips, and basal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous white field. Black pigmentation forms a continuous jagged border along the trailing edge and encompasses both distal tips. A concentrated, irregular black cluster with 'flame-like' protrusions is mapped at the central base (peduncle junction) extending upwards toward the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a measured aperture of approximately 72 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits a prominent U-shaped indentation roughly mid-way between the notch and the tip. Right lobe trailing edge shows smaller, more rhythmic saw-tooth peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to the outer lateral boundaries of both lobes extending from the water line to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, tan-colored clusters of raised pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A single circular white pixel spot is visible against the black trailing edge margin on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged trauma marks along the trailing edge boundary. A distinct, small reddish-pink vertical linear mark is present on the lower white quadrant of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetrical black 'spearhead' pigmentation pattern at the fluke base, providing high contrast against the surrounding white field.
